name: vice-code
description: A Miami sunset for Claude Code: the app's colors and a skyline at dusk behind the conversation. One command adds the game: your usage limits as a wanted level, with a HUD, stats and a radio. Unofficial fan mod, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or any game publisher.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: lite is the look alone: colors and the skyline. full adds the game: usage limits as a wanted level, a HUD above the prompt, gear on tool rows, stats. Switch any time with /vice lite and /vice full

switch.title: Switch above the prompt
switch.description: Show the Off / Look / Game switch above the prompt in the desktop and mobile apps. Hide or show it any time with /vice switch; the commands /vice off, /vice lite and /vice full work either way

colors.title: App colors
colors.description: Paint the desktop and mobile apps in the look's colors: violet stock, pink accent, in a light and a dark version

backdrop.title: Skyline backdrop
backdrop.description: Draw the skyline behind the conversation in the desktop and mobile apps. By day it is the sunset, at night the moon is up; in the game it shows the wanted level: patrol lights, then a helicopter. Toggle any time with /vice backdrop

paper.title: Scene paper
paper.description: auto prints the scene on light paper in a light window and on dark stock in a dark one; pick one if the picture does not match your window (also /vice paper dark)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows the language you write prompts in

playerName.title: Player name
playerName.description: Name on the welcome card; empty uses your account name

weapons.title: Gear on tool rows
weapons.description: Game: show a gear label (SHOTGUN for Bash, PISTOL for Edit...) next to each tool call

spinner.title: Miami spinner
spinner.description: Game: replace the spinner words with Miami phrases

toasts.title: Street talk
toasts.description: Game: show a short line now and then after a turn

toastEvery.title: Street talk every N turns
toastEvery.description: How many finished turns between two lines; never more often than every 20 minutes

showCost.title: Show cash
showCost.description: Show the session cost in the HUD

importHistory.title: Import history
importHistory.description: Game: count past sessions from your local Claude Code transcripts (read on this machine only; Lite reads none)

radioVolume.title: Radio volume
radioVolume.description: 0 is silent, 1 is normal, up to 2 boosts (macOS)

radioUrl.title: Your radio link
radioUrl.description: A Spotify, Apple Music or YouTube link the 'Your radio' button opens

wanted.title: Wanted level
wanted.description: Game: usage limits as a wanted system: stars for the 5-hour window, armor for the week, busted when a limit runs out

hud.title: HUD above the prompt
hud.description: Game: full shows the wanted level, health, armor and cash; compact only the wanted level; off hides the line (a bust still shows)

sounds.title: Sound effects
sounds.description: A siren at four stars and when busted, a chime for a medkit (macOS)
